item.text: The crash is caused by an ownership-boundary mismatch: `ingest.rows()` currently returns each comma-separated record as one combined field. I’ll make the analytics calculation tolerate both the intended `{"amount": ...}` shape and that combined-field shape, and set the requested currency unit.
